title: Funding AI for lasting impact
description: Funders are growing increasingly interested in artificial intelligence (AI). Across the social sector, AI-powered solutions are being explored to improve learning outcomes, strengthen healthcare systems, support frontline workers, identify vulnerable populations, and make nonprofit operations more efficient.
